description: Two suites. `quick` is the default: fourteen contracts chosen for dense use of the handlers the model is offered, one per template, on Ethereum for fast RPC; it runs in about half an hour and is what a change to the prompt, the checks or the loop is measured with. `unreachable` names handler fields the model could not have written, with the reason, so a miss there is expected rather than counted. `projects` is the full suite, ported from the discovery-v2 research benchmark so its numbers stay comparable: add a project there and every later full run includes it; leave addresses out to run every verified contract of the project that has a committed template.
